title: MuiCache application names
whyItMatters: MuiCache stores display names for programs the user launched, revealing app installs that may no longer be present.
notes: Value data is not read. This rule reports the presence and size of the cache, not the application names inside it.

steps: Only if you are not doing the full reset at the end of this plan, and you are comfortable with Registry Editor:
Open Registry Editor and go to the key named in the plan; Windows has no settings page for this cache.
Delete the key, then close Registry Editor.
cleanup.risk: Removes the cached program name list for this account. Windows refills it when programs are started again.
